verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.adyen.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 and its index explicitly covers Adyen for Platforms. The Platforms documentation pages are also served as markdown (.md) variants, for example platforms.md and onboard-users.md, so an agent can be pointed at them directly. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs, evidence of an llms-full.txt or agent-specific usage guidance, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed OpenAPI paths returned 404).
